core_cases.prompt: Use To Spec to synthesize the agreed display-name change from the fixture sources. Blank or whitespace-only names must make register_user raise ValueError("display name required"); valid names remain unchanged. Write one lightweight local spec at .scratch/display-name-validation/spec.md, include public acceptance examples and the register_user test seam, and do not implement or ask questions.

oracle.expected_outcome: One spec captures the exact error behavior, valid-name preservation, public register_user test examples, relevant constraints and sources, while production files remain unchanged.

assertions.description: creates .scratch/display-name-validation/spec.md and no other new specification artifact
the spec requires blank and whitespace-only values to raise ValueError with display name required and valid values to remain accepted
acceptance examples exercise register_user as the public seam and identify the project's unittest command
does not edit src/users.py, tests, Git state, or any external tracker

fixtures.content:
# Project Rules

Use Python 3.11 and unittest. Public validation errors use ValueError.

# User identity

Display name is the user-visible label. The team agreed that blank means empty or whitespace-only.
